dish: Nashville hot chicken sandwich; chicken and waffles
w: Verona tavern where chef Jacob Goldsberry (ex-Down Home Cookhouse) puts Southern fried chicken at the center (Cap Times feature); silver for Outdoor Dining in Best of Madison 2026.

dish: Cantonese-American classics in a 1980s-grand dining room
w: West-side Chinese institution voted Best of Madison every year since 1984; silver for East Asian in Best of Madison 2026; a Visit Middleton dining pick.

dish: The Grittyburger with Gritty Sauce — and a free birthday beer in a commemorative mug
w: Opened 1968 as a blues club, 'Madison's Official Birthday Bar' since 1985 (330,000 birthdays); rebuilt after a 2023 fire; silver for Burger in Best of Madison 2025. Doug Moe on its storied history (Madison Magazine).

dish: Reina pepiada arepa; pabellón criollo with guasacaca
w: Madison's Venezuelan restaurant (2013), family recipes from the Badell family — arepas, empanadas, patacón; gold for Latin American in Best of Madison 2026; repeatedly covered by Isthmus and the Cap Times.
